title: Differentially Private Verification of Distribution Properties
abstract: arXiv:2604.10819v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A recent line of work initiated by Chiesa and Gur and further developed by Herman and Rothblum investigates the sample and communication complexity of verifying properties of distributions with the assistance of a powerful, knowledgeable, but untrusted prover. In this work, we initiate the study of differentially private distribution property verification. After all, if we do not trust the prover to help us with verification, why should we trust it with our sensitive sample? We map a landscape of differentially private verification of properties of distributions. In the non-private case it is known that one-round private-coin protocols can have substantially lower complexity than public-coin (AM) protocols. In contrast, the possibility for improvement in differentially private interactive proofs depends on the privacy parameter regime and model. Drawing on connections between privacy and replicability and privacy amplification

translated_title: 差分隐私下的分布性质验证
translated_abstract: 近期由Chiesa和Gur发起，并由Herman和Rothblum进一步发展的研究线路，探讨了在强大、知识渊博但不可信的证明者协助下，验证分布性质的样本和通信复杂性。在本工作中，我们开创性地研究了差分隐私下的分布性质验证。毕竟，如果我们不信任证明者来协助验证，又为何要信任它处理我们的敏感样本呢？我们绘制了差分隐私分布性质验证的景观。在非隐私情况下，已知单轮私有硬币协议可以比公共硬币（AM）协议具有显著更低的复杂性。相反，在差分隐私交互式证明中改进的可能性取决于隐私参数范围和模型。我们借鉴了隐私与可复制性以及隐私放大之间的联系。
tldr: 本文首次研究了差分隐私下的分布性质验证，揭示了在隐私保护约束下，交互式证明协议的性能提升取决于隐私参数和模型，并利用了隐私与可复制性及隐私放大之间的联系。
en_tdlr: This paper initiates the study of differentially private distribution property verification, showing that improvements in interactive proof protocols under privacy constraints depend on the privacy parameter regime and model, leveraging connections between privacy, replicability, and privacy amplification.
